quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary reproductions explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 are capped at confidence 98 until a direct official raw PI row is read.
quality.duplicate_policy: Candidate novelty is checked against canonical prior reports, not only GitHub text-search hits; Part88 readback prevented two false 'new' candidates.
quality.no_data_policy: Missing explicit 2024 PI annual-Air-mass data is NO_DATA_CONTINUE, never zero.
quality.apr_policy: APR values are crosschecks only and are never silently substituted for PI rows.
quality.year_policy: Only explicit calendar-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows are promoted.

official_source_paths.retrieval: Official 2024 PI ZIP path retained. Known binary-client failure was not loop-retried; no direct row is claimed.

semantic_guards: Renewable-fuel CO2 is a subset and is never added to total CO2.
Measured/Calculated/Estimated is a source reporting method, not project measured state.
Only explicit calendar-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows are promoted.
Explicit 2024 blank and 2025 populated means 2025-only, never zero.
Flattened mixed-year single values remain fail-closed until year placement is preserved.
APR values are not substituted for PI annual-mass rows.
Waste tonnage and permit limits are not annual emissions.
Direct official raw PI row remains required before numeric confidence >=99.
